        ### Question
        A 62-year-old man with type 2 diabetes mellitus of 10 years of evolution performs treatment with metformin and sitagliptin. Does little physical exercise and performs a proper diet. The most appropriate therapeutic measure to perform is:

        ### Options

opb. Associate a dose of basal insulin with the treatment.
opc. Associate acarbose treatment.
opd. Replace sitagliptin with pioglitazone.
ope. Replace metformin with glimepiride.
